clips.name: Rodri
clips.caption: Standing/posing shot during a match, not a studio portrait. Player wears a light blue shirt with white trim and white shorts; visible sponsor "Etihad Airways" on the chest and a circular club crest on the left chest and left short. No visible squad number; short dark hair and athletic/stocky build.
